svg.data-input-voltage: 100-240 VAC 50/60 Hz, or -24 to -60 VDC wide range
svg.data-psu-redundancy: two hot-swappable supply bays; the base ships one AC supply and a blank
svg.data-operating-temp: AC system -20 to 65 C; DC system -40 to 65 C
svg.data-services: MPLS L2/L3 VPN, VPWS, VPLS, H-VPLS, 802.1Q, 802.1ad
svg.data-resiliency: G.8031, sub-50 ms G.8032v2 R-APS and MSTP fast ring, sub-50 ms RSVP-TE FRR, H-VPLS dual homing, LAG
svg.data-timing: SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 PTP, BITS and phase clock
svg.data-multicast: IGMP snooping v1/v2/v3, IGMP proxy, MVR
svg.data-local: CON serial console and ETH out-of-band Ethernet on RJ45; DA-15 alarm inputs and outputs
svg.data-mgmt-protocols: Console, Telnet, SSHv2, RADIUS, TACACS+, SNMP v1/2/3, xFTP, NTP, DHCP, NAT, ZTP
svg.data-safety: C-UL 60950, CSA 22.2 No. 950, EN/IEC 60950, TUV/GS, CB, EN 60825-1/2 (2016 edition)
